content: समुद्धत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Upraised, uplifted, elevated. .²2 Excited, drawn up. .²3 Puffed up with pride, proud, arrogant; ततस्तपोवीर्यसमुद्धतस्य पारं यियासोः समरार्णवस्य <ls>Ki. 17. 35</ls>. .²4 Ill-mannered, ill-behaved. .²5 Impudent, rude. .²6 Intense, violent; अशक्ता धारणे देव तेजस्तव समुद्धतम् <ls>Rām. 1. 37. 15</ls>.
